name: Euler's Totient Inequality on Prime Map
description: Replaces the cubic equation that explicitly sets roots at $0, f_u, f_v$ with an inequality involving Euler's totient function on the product of characteristic primes mapped from the values 1, 2, 3. The inequality $\phi(p \times q) < p \times q - \sqrt{p \times q}$ holds strictly if and only if $p \neq q$. This completely obfuscates the $f_u \neq f_v$ condition behind number theory properties, preventing LLMs from pattern-matching it to graph 3-coloring.
